title: Fantastic DIY Speakers for less than $30!
summary: Tech Ingredients shows how to build cheap, high-performance flat-panel speakers using audio exciters on sheet materials such as foam-core board. It explains how distributed-mode speakers work and walks through experiments to find good designs.
why: Pointed to by hobbyists interested in building flat-panel DIY speakers from cheap materials.

quote.text: where he goes into all sorts of experiments he ran on the exciters to find the right design.
